name: Project Intelligence Layer & Brownfield Repository Analysis
description: A privacy-first, fully offline codebase intelligence pipeline orchestrating tokei, lizard, dependency-cruiser, code-maat, semgrep, and tree-sitter-analyzer to produce 7 structured JSON artifacts. Serves two modes: (1) greenfield post-track hook building a living ecosystem map in superconductor/intelligence/ to reduce agent context token load by 10-15x, and (2) brownfield standalone analysis of any unknown repository producing a Repository Health Report. First mover: no competitor currently wires offline static analysis tools into an agent context loop natively.
